name: Chili Pepper
description: Chili peppers are fruits of plants in the genus Capsicum, native to the Americas and later spread around the world through the Columbian Exchange.

events.title: Chili peppers were domesticated in the Americas
events.description: Capsicum peppers were domesticated in the Americas thousands of years ago. Mesoamerica became an important center for the cultivation and use of chili peppers.

events.title: Chili peppers were cultivated in Mexico
events.description: Chili peppers were widely cultivated and incorporated into food traditions in pre-Columbian Mexico.

events.title: Chili peppers were introduced to Spain
events.description: Chili peppers reached Spain soon after the Columbian Exchange and were subsequently cultivated in Europe.

events.title: Chili peppers were introduced to India
events.description: Chili peppers were introduced to South Asia during the early period of Portuguese maritime trade and became deeply integrated into regional cuisines.

events.title: Chili peppers spread through Southeast Asia
events.description: Chili peppers spread through Southeast Asia during the early modern period and became important ingredients in many regional cuisines.
